name: Four Seasons Hotel Chicago
positioning: Four Seasons hotel on 19 floors of the 900 North Michigan skyscraper, at the heart of the Magnificent Mile, with lake and skyline views
best_for: Travelers who want a Magnificent Mile base with Lake Michigan views
Families wanting a suite or residence with a separate bedroom

facts.text: The hotel is at 120 East Delaware Place, Chicago.
The Hotel occupies 19 floors of the 66-storey 900 North Michigan skyscraper.
Adorn Restaurant features globally inspired cuisine and cocktails.
Mile High Cocktail Club is an intimate speakeasy 46 floors above the city.
Tasse is a coffee bar on the 7th floor of the hotel.
The hotel has a 44-foot (13-metre) indoor pool.
The Fitness Centre is open 24 hours.
Guests have access to 900 shops one floor below the Hotel.

highlights.text: The hotel offers lake and skyline views at the heart of the Magnificent Mile.
Lake-View Rooms have oversized windows that offer an impressive view of Lake Michigan.
The Luxury Residence has a separate bedroom, living room and kitchenette.
Luxury Residence guests can enjoy access to an expansive 30th-floor terrace.
Adorn has resident musicians weekly, including DJs who spin house, funk and disco Thursday to Saturday evenings.

considerations.text: Valet parking is USD 89 per night.
Self-parking in the 900 North Michigan building is USD 58 per night.
Travel time from O'Hare International Airport is 30 to 60 minutes by car.
WhataHotel notes a downtown location with typical urban noise levels.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
